topic: Pay Off Credit Cards or Other High Interest Debt
subtopic: Pay Off Credit Cards or Other High Interest Debt
source_evidence: If you’ve got unpaid balances on several credit cards, you should first pay down the card that charges the highest rate.
question: If you owe balances on several credit cards, which one should you prioritize paying down?
answer: Prioritize the card with the highest interest rate. Pay as much as you can toward that balance while continuing to make the minimum payments on your other cards.
